user.title: Add room
user.description: Only the essentials. Everything else (times, colors, TV, sleep …) can be set afterwards via “Configure”.

data_description.night_lights: Only these lights are used at night and in sleep mode. Empty = all.
data_description.presence_sensors: Lights turn on when any of these is on.
data_description.dark_sensor: When this sensor is on, it counts as dark.

error.night_lights_not_in_room: Night lights must also be selected as lights.

init.title: Settings: {room}
init.description: Pick an area. Changes are applied with “Save”.

basis.title: Lights and sensors
basis.description: Which lights belong to the room, and what reports presence?

data_description.night_lights: Only these lights are used at night and in sleep mode. Empty = all.
data_description.presence_sensors: Lights turn on when any of these is on.

dunkelheit.title: When is it dark?
dunkelheit.description: Without darkness and lux sensor, the sun is used.

data_description.dark_sensor: When this sensor is on, it counts as dark.
data_description.lux_sensor: Below the threshold the room counts as dark. Without darkness and lux sensor, the sun is used.

zeiten.title: Turning off and times
zeiten.description: When lights turn off and when night starts.

data.override_timeout: End manual mode at the latest after

data_description.off_delay: How long the room must be empty before lights turn off.
data_description.dim_before_off: Lights stay dimmed this long as a warning. 0 = off immediately.
data_description.learning: If lights are needed again shortly after auto-off, the delay grows; it shrinks slowly after correct offs.
data_description.override_timeout: 0 = only after the room was empty.

licht.title: Brightness, color and scenes
licht.description: Expand each mode. A scene replaces brightness and color. Priority: sleep, TV, night, evening, day.

data_description.adaptive: Between day and evening, brightness and color temperature follow the sun elevation.

data_description.media_entity: While it is on, the room counts as occupied and uses TV mode.
data_description.sleep_entity: When on, sleep mode applies in addition to the room switch.
data_description.bedtime: Lights dim slowly to sleep light before; at bedtime sleep mode turns on. It turns off at night end.
data_description.late_entity: e.g. a no-school sensor: bedtime is 60 minutes later.

data.blocker_entities: Keep on while any is on

data_description.trigger_sensors: Turn lights on early but do not count as presence.
data_description.path_sensors: At night, when one turns off (got up), the night lights of this room turn on. Back on = off.
data_description.welcome_persons: When one of these people arrives home in the dark, lights turn on (at least 5 minutes).
data_description.blocker_entities: e.g. game console, speaker or a guest switch.

haus.title: House mode
haus.description: Optional. Away keeps lights off, vacation runs an evening presence simulation.

data_description.house_mode_entity: Away keeps lights off, vacation runs an evening presence simulation.

error.night_lights_not_in_room: Night lights must also be selected as lights.

set_sleep_mode.name: Set sleep mode
set_sleep_mode.description: Turn sleep mode on or off for all or selected rooms.

reset.name: Reset automation
reset.description: End manual mode in all or selected rooms.

set_enabled.name: Automation on/off
set_enabled.description: Turn automation on or off for all or selected rooms.

flash.name: Light notification
flash.description: Flashes the lights briefly, by default only in occupied rooms.

presence_stuck.title: Presence sensor stuck: {room}
presence_stuck.description: {entity} has reported presence for more than {hours} hours. Check battery, sensitivity or position. Lights in {room} stay on meanwhile.

light_unavailable.title: Light unavailable: {room}
light_unavailable.description: {entity} has been unavailable for more than an hour. Check power or connection.
